rules.statement: A donor can renounce the right to revoke a Kandyan deed of gift, making it irrevocable, provided such agreement is not subversive of the essential requisites of a contract.
rules.supporting_quote: "In view of the law as laid down in the decided cases, it cannot be said that an agreement renouncing the right to revoke is subversive of the essential character of a gift under the Kandyan law."
